main.summary: Half-open byte range within a staged transfer stream.

property.name: Offset
property.summary: Starting byte offset of the range.

property.name: Length
property.summary: Length in bytes of the range.

property.name: EndOffsetExclusive
property.summary: Exclusive ending offset of the range.

property.name: IsEmpty
property.summary: Whether the range length is zero.

method.name: Validate
method.summary: Determine whether the range is non-negative and does not overflow.
method.returns: True when the range is valid.

method.name: ContainsRange
method.summary: Determine whether this range fully contains another range.
method.returns: True when the candidate range is fully contained.

method.name: Intersects
method.summary: Determine whether this range intersects another range.

method.name: CanMerge
method.summary: Determine whether this range can be merged with another range because they intersect or are adjacent.
method.returns: True when the ranges may be merged.

method.name: Merge
method.summary: Merge this range with another intersecting or adjacent range.
